title: Peaceful Easy Feeling #B | KEY.co
description_expanded: The third floor is a haven for relaxation and socializing, featuring a modern kitchen equipped with new appliances, a large island, and bar stools—perfect for gathering and enjoying the company. Adjacent to the kitchen, the living area offers plush seating and a large flat-screen TV, positioned beside a dining table that accommodates eight guests, all set against the backdrop of the sparkling Emerald Coast. Step outside onto the balcony to find a cozy bed swing, ideal for enjoying morning coffee or unwinding with a book amidst the salty beach breeze. Just a short walk from the tranquil Walton Dunes Beach Access, this home not only provides luxurious indoor comforts but also easy access to sandy adventures and a private pool for exclusive enjoyment. Discover the allure of coastal living in Santa Rosa Beach with this charming gulf view duplex, perfectly situated to offer an authentic 30A beach vacation experience. This inviting home provides a family-friendly atmosphere across its two stories, boasting four well-appointed bedrooms, including two king bedrooms—one with an en-suite featuring double vanities and a modern walk-in shower. The queen bedroom and a delightful bunk room add to the versatility, making it an ideal retreat for families or groups. The open floor plan enhances the sense of space, where a living room and kitchen open onto a balcony that captures serene water views, decorated to reflect the crystal-clear gulf and refreshing beach air.

Features: Four beach cruiser bikes are included
along with an elevator serving all three floors.
